notes.range: Best within 18 m: full damage, 5 body shots. Down to 40 % (11 shots) by 45 m; reaches 110 m. Standard ballistics: by impact speed, the same distances.
notes.model: The owner's own Glock 19 Modular Sidearm (Meshy, owned, 2026-11-27; content/guns.json), sharper copies in your own hands at Medium and High; it replaced the 3DModelsCC0 Makarov. The flat-colour kit pistol is the fallback.
notes.design: Benchmark A (service pistol): instant handling, moderate damage and velocity, low recoil, true first shot, fast reload.
notes.fireMode: One shot per click; holding the trigger doesn't keep firing (the Machine Pistol is the automatic one).
